title: A single continuous handheld handycam shot in slow motion, drifting and weaving…
content: A single continuous handheld handycam shot in slow motion, drifting and weaving organically through a completely frozen party scene, every person suspended mid-movement like a living diorama. The shaky camera circles and floats slowly. Single seamless slow-motion take.

es.content:

La cámara temblorosa circula y flota lentamente. Toma continua sin cortes en cámara lenta.
